justification: Accepted boundary: this module IS the audited subprocess boundary of the repository. Every helper is argv-first (runCommand, runCommandOk, captureCommand, runCommandLine, captureCommandLine) and the only shell paths are the deliberate captureShell escape hatch and the Windows .cmd shim fallback, which exists because npm/vercel/gh are batch files Node cannot exec without one. All callers pass repo-authored literals, never data. Fix at the call sites, not here. Reviewed 2026-10-11.
